# Bid the stop, not the room special.

> Price a carpet cleaning job from soil-specific extraction rates: rooms, stairs, pet-urine extra passes, upholstery, furniture moving, and drive time — plus the walk-away number a $129 three-bedroom special hides.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
